sections.description:
Gutentools is a powerful block editor plugin designed for seamless full-site editing. It offers a range of customizable blocks, including page and post sliders, containers, and more, all with flexible responsive controls. With an intuitive drag-and-drop visual editor, you can easily create engaging layouts and dynamic content for any device.
Unlock the full potential of WordPress with blocks that are tailored for a smooth design experience.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services to provide its functionality:

Gutentools Demo Content API:
– What it does: This API provides demo content and configuration data for the plugin’s blocks and features.
– Data Sent: The plugin sends API requests to https://demos.gutentools.com/wp-json/wp/v2/ to fetch demo content and block configurations. No user-identifiable information is sent during this process.
– Data Received: Demo content and configuration settings required for the plugin to work as expected.
– Terms of Service: Gutentools Demo API Terms
– Privacy Policy: Gutentools Demo API Privacy Policy

Local File Usage:
– What it does: The plugin reads block configuration files from the plugin’s directory (e.g., block.json) to dynamically register and load block settings.
– Data Sent: None. The files are accessed locally on the server.
– Data Received: Block configuration settings that define how the blocks behave and render.
– Why it’s used: To dynamically load and register Gutenberg blocks from the plugin’s directory.

Please note that by using this plugin, you agree to the terms of the external services mentioned above.

sections.faq:
How to insert blocks of Gutentools Blocks in your page or post?

Install and activate Gutentools Blocks for Gutenberg on your website. Create a new page and click the ‘+’ sign, and you will find all the creative Gutenberg blocks there. Now click on the block you want to insert in your page and create amazing pages.

How to save a block as a reusable block?

You can save any block from Gutentools Blocks for Gutenberg as a reusable block easily. Click on any block you want to save as reusable, then click on the ‘Add to reusable blocks,’ and instantly, that block will be converted into a reusable block.

What themes do Gutentools Blocks For Gutenberg support?

Gutentools Blocks for Gutenberg has no theme dependency. This Gutenberg blocks plugin is compatible with any updated WordPress theme.

Will Gutentools Blocks slow down my website speed?

No, Gutentools Blocks will not slow down your website.

I do not know how to code. Can I still use Gutentools Blocks?

Yes, you can still use Gutentools Blocks. These Gutenberg blocks are created in such a way that you can use them and customize them without code.

How can I get ready templates for Gutentools Blocks?

You can use our demo importer to insert ready to use templates & Patterns

Can I get ready Gutenberg patterns from Gutentools Blocks?

Yes, Gutentools Blocks provides you with a ready, professionally designed Gutenberg pattern.

Does Gutentools Blocks has any plugin dependency?

You only need the Gutenberg block editor to use Gutentools Blocks plugin on your WordPress website. Then you can use Gutentools Blocks and create stunning pages.

Does Gutentools Blocks provide any WooCommerce blocks for Gutenberg?

Yes, Blocks are coming soon.

sections.reviews:
Great Gutenberg Plugin with Useful Blocks

By rabinld on September 9, 2026

Gutentools is a really useful plugin for anyone building websites with the WordPress block editor. The blocks are easy to use, flexible, and give you more options for creating professional-looking pages without needing to write code.

I especially like the variety of blocks and the responsive customization options. It makes building sections such as sliders, FAQs, testimonials, team members, call-to-actions, and other content much easier.

The plugin is lightweight, straightforward to work with, and fits nicely into a Gutenberg-based workflow. The developers also seem to be actively maintaining and improving it, which is always a big plus.

Overall, a great addition to WordPress for anyone who wants more flexibility with Gutenberg. Highly recommended! 

Excellent Support and Helpful Plugin

By bishalkce on August 18, 2026

I’m really happy with Gutentools. The plugin is easy to use, but what impressed me most is the support. The team is responsive, professional, and genuinely helpful whenever I have questions or run into an issue. They take the time to understand the problem and provide clear solutions. Great plugin with excellent customer support — highly recommended!

Amazing Plugin – Works Perfectly!

By prabyn99 on March 28, 2025

I’ve been using this plugin for a while now, and it has exceeded my expectations! The setup was seamless, and the interface is intuitive, making it easy to use even for beginners. It integrates perfectly with my WordPress site, and the features are exactly what I needed.

Performance-wise, it’s super reliable, with no bugs or slowdowns. The developers have done a fantastic job maintaining and updating it, ensuring compatibility with the latest WordPress versions. Plus, the customer support is outstanding – quick responses and genuinely helpful solutions!

If you’re considering this plugin, don’t hesitate. It’s definitely one of the best out there. Highly recommended!

Fantastic Gutentools Plugin – A Must-Have!

By sameer3637 on March 27, 2025

I’ve been using this Gutentools plugin for a while now, and it has significantly improved my workflow. The plugin is lightweight, user-friendly, and seamlessly integrates with the block editor.
